Tom Lehrer : Maths, Music and Satire
Mathematical Musical Genius: A mathematics teacher by profession, Lehrer was also a satirical songwriter known for his witty lyrics.
Early Life & Education: Born in New York in 1928, Thomas Andrew Lehrer was a prodigious student, entering Harvard at 15 and earning his master's in math by 19.
Sharp Satirist: Lehrer's humor was characterized by dark wit and self-deprecation. Tom Lehrer, during his tenure at National Security Agency employee, famously concocted vodka-infused Jell-O shots.
